purpose: 保留两侧关于排除、绑定及轮询位置的真实帮助文字，供与下一步成功改绑的行为对照。
output:
usage: indexroom [demo|version|register|help]

register reads requests as JSON from standard input and maintains an
in-memory service instance registry with offline health observations:
  {"requests":[{"type":"register","service":"svc","expectedRevision":0,"instances":[{"id":"i1","address":"host:8080"}]},
              {"type":"health","service":"svc","instanceId":"i1","expectedRevision":1,"sequence":1,"healthy":true},
              {"type":"select","service":"svc","expectedRevision":1},
              {"type":"release_session","service":"svc","expectedRevision":1,"sessionKey":"user-42"}]}
A register request fully replaces the service's instance list; new services
require expectedRevision 0, existing services the current revision. A health
request records an offline observation (healthy/unhealthy) for one instance;
it never probes. Health updates never bump the registration revision. A
select request chooses one healthy instance, rotating per service by ascending
instance id; it performs no network access and never changes revisions or
health records, and reports invalid/conflict/not_found/no_healthy on failure.
A select request may carry an optional "sessionKey" string: requests in the
same service with the same trimmed key reuse the instance first chosen for
that key while it stays registered and healthy, without moving the rotation.
A select request may also carry an optional "excludeInstanceIds" array of
strings: the listed instances are skipped for that one request only, keeping
their registration and health records, and stay eligible for later requests.
A release_session request carries service, expectedRevision and a required
sessionKey; it drops that key's binding in the named service so the next
selection with the key joins the rotation again. It chooses no target, moves
no cursor, and succeeds without changed when the key has no binding.
Exit status is 0 only when every request succeeds and the JSON result
is fully written to standard output. A failed result write is reported
on standard error with the underlying write error and also exits 1,
without appending a second JSON document to the partial output.
